models.title: Forward price-to-earnings ratio
models.summary: The book defines the forward P/E multiple as share price divided by projected earnings per share.

relationship.locator: Learning Module2, Measures of Central Tendency, printed p115 (PDF p125), Example13 introduction and Exhibit42
relationship.translation_notes: Price and annual-window earnings per share are both currency/share amounts, yielding a dimensionless annual-earnings multiple under dimensionless financial-period convention; never convert years to seconds.

variables.definition: Price relative to projected annual earnings per share
variables.context: One entity, accounting scope, reporting currency, inventory cost basis and declared accounting period

assumptions: Price and projected EPS use the same currency, share class and split/share convention. EPS belongs to a named future annual reporting window.
Positive-earnings valuation interpretation requireseps>0; the broader arithmetic definition permitseps<0 with explicit loss meaning.
limitations: EPS0 makes the ratio undefined. A projected earnings input is supplied, not forecast here.
This is not a trailingP/E or a recommendation. Different forward windows must not be mixed.

models.title: Trailing EBITDA interest-expense coverage ratio
models.summary: The covenant example defines interest coverage as trailing-four-quarter EBITDA divided by matching interest expense.
